question: I'm baking Doc Detective 5 into a Docker image for our docs CI, and we test on Microsoft Edge. The Dockerfile line `RUN npx doc-detective install browsers edge --cache-dir /opt/dd-cache --yes` fails with `error: command-argument value 'edge' is invalid for argument 'names'. Allowed choices are chrome, firefox, chromedriver, geckodriver.` How do I get Edge into the image, and how do I make sure the test runs later use what's in /opt/dd-cache?

facts.text: Doc Detective doesn't run tests in Edge: `install browsers` takes only `chrome`, `firefox`, `chromedriver`, and `geckodriver`, and a spec or context that names `edge` as its browser is invalid in v5. Use Chrome.
Install Chrome into that cache with `npx doc-detective install browsers chrome --cache-dir /opt/dd-cache --yes`, or `install all` to add the runtime packages too.

Test runs must read the same cache, for example `ENV DOC_DETECTIVE_CACHE_DIR=/opt/dd-cache` in the image, `--cache-dir` on each run, or `cacheDir` in config; `--cache-dir` beats `DOC_DETECTIVE_CACHE_DIR`, which beats config `cacheDir`.

must_not: `install browsers` accepts Edge under another name, such as `msedge` or `edge-stable`, or through an option.
A context or `startSurface` with `edge` as the browser runs the tests in Edge.

replace.from: For the browser alone, use `npx doc-detective install browsers chrome --cache-dir /opt/dd-cache --yes`.
replace.to: To get Edge, use `npx doc-detective install browsers --browser edge --cache-dir /opt/dd-cache --yes`.

wrong.answer:
The asset name is `msedge`, not `edge`:

```dockerfile
RUN npx doc-detective install browsers msedge --cache-dir /opt/dd-cache --yes
ENV DOC_DETECTIVE_CACHE_DIR=/opt/dd-cache
```

Then name `edge` in your contexts' `browsers`.

replace.from: The first one set wins, in this order: `--cache-dir`, then `DOC_DETECTIVE_CACHE_DIR`, then `cacheDir` in the project config, then `cacheDir` in your user config.
replace.to: `DOC_DETECTIVE_CACHE_DIR` wins over everything, including `--cache-dir`, so set it once in the image.

wrong.answer:
Doc Detective has no Edge support. `install browsers` takes only `chrome`, `firefox`, `chromedriver`, and `geckodriver`, and Doc Detective 5 rejects `edge` as a browser. Install Chrome:

```dockerfile
RUN npx doc-detective install browsers chrome --yes
```
